findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now an abstract class that cannot be instantiated
findings.body: It now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with only `pass`. That base class has abstract members: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values and the new build_occurrence_and_event_data. Any call to `detector.detector_handler` for a metric_alert_fire detector will raise TypeError on instantiation. Previously it returned an empty list. This breaks process_detectors for that type. Either keep the old stub handler or implement the abstract methods.

findings.title: New abstract hook has no docstring and lacks a contract for event_data
findings.body: build_occurrence_and_event_data is a new abstract method that every subclass must implement. It has no docstring describing the expected contents of the returned event_data or how new_status maps to priority. The hook is a breaking change for existing subclasses and is undocumented.

findings.title: State committed after Kafka produce, with no failure handling
findings.body: Occurrences are produced inside the loop before handler.commit_state_updates() runs. If a produce raises midway, the dedupe and state updates are never committed. Already-produced occurrences will then be re-emitted on retry. The ordering was the same before, but the new hook makes it a real path.
